# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Cairn follows semantic versioning. Security fixes are issued for the latest
release line only.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 5.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 4.x     | :x:                |
| 3.x     | :x:                |
| 2.x     | :x:                |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security concern. Use GitHub's
